user.title: Connect two Home Assistant instances
user.description: Install Beam on the local instance. Enter administrator tokens and confirm the entity prefix used on that instance.

views.title: Choose what to synchronize
views.description: The selected source wins the first sync if the content differs. Afterwards, changes can travel both ways.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read both instances. Check the URLs and administrator tokens.
error.invalid_input: Enter two distinct Home Assistant URLs and a valid entity prefix.
error.mismatched_scope: Choose entire dashboards on both sides or an individual view on both sides.
error.no_dashboards: Create an editable dashboard on each instance first.

abort.overlap: One of these dashboards or views is already managed by another rule.
